Hotel Sales & Representation

B2B Hotel Sales Representation in India

Develop hotel accounts across agents, wholesalers and event buyers with criteria for quality, pricing and repeat production.

Discuss your project

Prioritise accounts with realistic demand

Rank prospects by booking pattern, segment fit, payment reputation and the team's ability to service them. A partner with modest but steady shoulder-season demand can be valuable.

Make training measurable

Give sellers sample itineraries and rate conditions before the first training session. Track whether they send viable quotes and produce repeat stays after follow-up.
